_comment: composable_tv [lin] arm — linearized (tangent-space) task vectors on Llama-3.2-1B. Canonical ctv schema + arm extras: irp_seed seeds the frozen A projections (per-(author,layer) SHA-256, linear_tv.seeded_A); serve=linear is the method (nonlinear-debug = the 2x2 fallback via eval_tofu --linear_tv_serve); retry = the pre-registered train_linear_tv --rank_override/--lr_override arm; compose defaults to 'sum' (set 'mean' for the ctv_lin_mean_* labels — fixed lambda keeps drop-a-term exact). Pool authors derive at runtime from merge_subset.subset_authors(pool_seed, pool_size) — never hardcoded.
